name: Inotribe (version C)
description: Version C of the five-page Inotribe site, built from the same requirements and copy as versions A and B so all three can be compared. Charcoal (#141414) with a fine film grain; the logo's teal and gold as the only colours, used as blocks. One signature move: large Satoshi headlines where the key phrase turns gold. Switzer for reading, Plex Mono for small labels, hairline rules and square edges. Home: a case-study kicker, headline and proof points beside an annotated photo (callouts pinned by leader lines, a live Accra clock, gentle parallax), the shipped systems as linked tiles, capabilities as cards beside a sticky column with the numbers, a full-width split with an illustrative one-API request on a teal half, case studies as hover list rows, the stack as a big-type marquee, clients in a ruled grid and a centred gold call to action with a round button. About: photo mosaic, mission quote beside the client column, four differentiators in a row, process as stacked steps beside a sticky heading, a centred testimonial slider and a four-cell partner grid. Services: photo with an overlapping statement, four tall project columns, services list beside a sticky photo, and a ruled principles table. Work: spec sheets from JSON beside a sticky contents list. Contact: form first with the photo and details in a side column. Navbar, menu, footer, privacy notice and scroll ring are injected from main.js.
